title: Why evals come before prompts
body: Write 20 test prompts first and run them on every change. If you cannot measure a regression you cannot ship a prompt change.

title: MCP tools should be small and typed
body: Prefer several narrow tools with typed arguments over one tool that takes a free-form string. The schema is the contract the model sees.

title: RAG: hybrid beats pure vector
body: Combining keyword and vector search with a reranker usually retrieves better than vector search alone, especially for names and codes.

title: Trace every agent run
body: Record each step with latency and token counts. A run you cannot replay is a run you cannot debug.

title: Staged rollouts for prompt changes
body: Ship a prompt change to a small slice first, compare against the baseline, then widen. Treat prompts like code.
